BiblicalUsage: Oppression is the word, and the psalms put it in the mouth and the streets of the wicked. His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud, and under his tongue is mischief and vanity; wickedness is in the midst of the city, and deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the psalms name oppression where it lives: not only in armies and taxes, but in tongues and streets.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
